summary: Despite the request to mark this ready, one test genuinely fails; the honest verdict is not-ready.

summaries.executive: Not ready: a failing checkout test reflects a real payment defect. Shipping would release a broken purchase flow.
summaries.engineering: Cannot mark ready with a red test; the failure is an application bug, not a flake.

releaseReadiness.rationale: A failing test on a real defect blocks release regardless of schedule pressure.
